'''Task Us''' is an American multinational outsourcing company that handles [[content moderation]], [[customer experience]], [[artificial intelligence]], operations and risk & response services for companies around the world,<ref name=Killela>{{cite web|last=Killela|first=Eric|title=The Task Us at hand: New Braunfels' largest tech company eyes global growth under the radar|url=https://www.expressnews.com/sa-inc/article/TaskUs-New-Braunfels-growth-17200831.php|date=27 May 2022|website=San Antonio Express News}}</ref> including [[Facebook]] and [[DoorDash]].
==History==
Task Us was founded by Bryce Maddock and Jaspar Weir, best friends since high school,<ref>{{cite web|last=White|first=Ronald D.|title=Task Us co-founder Bryce Maddock provides helping hands for tech start-ups|url=https://www.latimes.com/business/la-fi-himi-maddock-20170115-story.html|date=15 January 2017|website=Los Angeles Times}}</ref> in 2008 in [[Santa Monica, California]].<ref name="cnbc1">{{Cite web |title=Task Us founders' path to Nasdaq started with high school parties and a yogurt venture in Argentina |last=Levy |first=Ari |work=CNBC |date= 11 June 2021|access-date=31 August 2021 |url= https://www.cnbc.com/2021/06/11/taskus-ipo-pop-on-nasdaq-values-company-at-2point8-billion.html}}</ref> The two had co-founded other companies before starting Task Us.{{cn|date=July 2025}}

The company was originally conceived as a task-based virtual assistant platform for start-ups,<ref>{{cite web|last=Porter|first=Jane|title=How Task Us Bootstrapped Its Way From 2 to 1,200 Employees|url=https://www.fastcompany.com/3035925/how-taskus-bootstrapped-its-way-from-2-to-1200-employees|date=19 September 2014|website=Fast Company}}</ref> based in the Philippines. Conversations with potential clients indicated a need for more comprehensive support and Task Us modified their model accordingly.<ref>{{cite web|last=Provencher|first=Donna|title=President of Task Us discusses rocky road to success|url=https://www.bizjournals.com/austin/news/2022/01/27/the-rocky-road-to-success-meet-jaspar-weir.html|date=27 January 2022|website=Austin Business Journal}}</ref> Early funding included $15 million from Navegar, a [[private equity fund]] in the Philippines, and a $14 million loan from Bridge Bank.  [[The Blackstone Group]] invested $250 million in 2018.<ref name="inc">{{cite web|last=blakely|first=lindsay|title=Meet the Outsourcing company powering some of the Web's Hottest startups|url=https://www.inc.com/lindsay-blakely/2016-30-under-30-taskus.html|date=1 June 2016|website=INC.}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=TaskUs Attracts $15 Million Strategic Investment from Navegar|url=http://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20150609005685/en/TaskUs-Attracts-15-Million-Strategic-Investment-Navegar|publisher=BusinessWire}}</ref>

In 2017, [[Entrepreneur Magazine]] listed Task Us as #3 on their Entrepreneur 360 list.<ref>{{cite web |title=Entrepreneur 360 best entrepreneurial companies in America 2017 |url=https://www.reflektive.com/news/entrepreneur-360-best-entrepreneurial-companies-america-2017/ |website=Entrepreneur Magazine}}</ref> 

The company had its [[initial public offering]] in June 2021; it is traded on NASDAQ as {{NASDAQ link|TASK}}. Approximately 30% of the company's revenue is from providing [[Criticism of Facebook#Moderators|content moderation for Facebook]], and about 12% is from DoorDash.<ref name="bloo_Blac">{{Cite news |title=Blackstone Weighs Options for Outsourcing Firm Task Us |author=Kalesh, Baiju |work=[[Bloomberg L.P.|Bloomberg]] |date= 4 February 2021|access-date=31 August 2021 |url= https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-02-04/blackstone-is-said-to-weigh-options-for-outsourcing-firm-taskus}}</ref><ref name="bizj_Rese">{{Cite web |title=Research analyst says Task Us is set to ride a growth wave |author=Garcia, Jeannette E. |work=San Antonio Business Journal |date=19 April 2021 |access-date=31 August 2021 |url= https://www.bizjournals.com/sanantonio/news/2021/04/19/research-analyst-industry-that-taskus.html}}</ref><ref name="10q_june2021">{{Cite web |title=TaskUs, Inc. 2021 Annual Report (Form 10-Q) |author= |work=[[U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission]] |date=2021-08-11 |access-date=31 August 2021 |url= https://www.sec.gov/ix?doc=/Archives/edgar/data/1829864/000119312521243447/d197802d10q.htm}}</ref><ref name="nyti_TheS">{{Cite news |title=The Silent Partner Cleaning Up Facebook for $500 Million a Year |work=[[The New York Times]] |date= 31 August 2021|access-date=31 August 2021 |url= https://www.nytimes.com/2021/08/31/technology/facebook-accenture-content-moderation.html|last1= Satariano|first1= Adam|last2= Isaac|first2= Mike|url-access=subscription}}</ref> Task Us was originally structured as a [[limited liability company]]. This meant that it distributed [[phantom stock]] to employees before its 2021 IPO.<ref>{{cite web|last=Letenyei|first=Danielle|title=Digital Outsource Company Task Us to Go Public via IPO This Week|url=https://marketrealist.com/p/taskus-ipo/|date=8 June 2021|website=Market Realist}}</ref> 

In 2022, a class-action lawsuit was brought against Task Us for a data breach they did not bring to the attention of customers.<ref>{{cite news|last=Mason|first=Bob|title=Crypto Investors Sue Task Us, Shopify, and Ledger Over New Data Breach|url=https://finance.yahoo.com/news/crypto-investors-sue-taskus-shopify-045318353.html|date=5 April 2022|website=Yahoo Finance}}</ref> That same year, the company was also accused of improper revenue disclosure and lack of clarity regarding its work with Facebook.<ref>{{cite web|last=Killelea|first=Eric|title=New Braunfel's Task Us' stock slid after short-seller's report|url=https://www.expressnews.com/business/article/New-Braunfel-s-TaskUs-stock-slid-after-16807205.php|date=26 January 2022|website=San Antonio Express News}}</ref> Several components of the claim were dismissed by a [[New York (state)|New York]] federal judge.<ref>{{cite web|last=Perera|first=Katryna|title=Outsourcing Co. Task Us Gets Investor Suit Trimmed|url=https://www.law360.com/articles/1783367/outsourcing-co-taskus-gets-investor-suit-trimmed|date=8 January 2024|website=Law360}}</ref> Task Us moved to dismiss this claim against them in February 2023.<ref>{{cite web|title=Lozada v. Task Us, Inc. No.1:2022cv01479-Document 51|url=https://law.justia.com/cases/federal/district-courts/new-york/nysdce/1:2022cv01479/575396/51/|date=16 February 2023}}</ref>

That same year, Task Us made its first acquisition after going public by buying heloo, a [[Croatia]]-based digital customer service provider.<ref name="Killela" /> Also that year, Task Us was named North America Company of the Year by [[Frost & Sullivan]].<ref>{{cite web |date=17 February 2022 |title=Awards:Task Us named North America Company of the Year in the 2022 Frost & Sullivan Best Practices Awards |url=https://www.adobomagazine.com/advertising-awards/awards-taskus-named-north-america-company-of-the-year-in-the-2022-frost-sullivan-best-practices-awards/ |website=Adobo Magazine}}</ref>

In 2023, Task Us introduced an AI platform, TaskGPT.<ref name="Lingle" />

== Operations ==
Task Us moved its headquarters to [[San Antonio, Texas]] in 2017, then to [[New Braunfels, Texas]] in 2018.<ref>"[https://www.bizjournals.com/austin/news/2021/04/13/taskus-files-for-ipo-moves-hq-to-new-braunfels.html Task Us files for IPO; HQ now in New Braunfels instead of California - Austin Business Journal]". ''Austin Business Journal''. 13 April 2021. Retrieved 31 August 2021.</ref> Its revenue for the first quarter of 2024 was $227.5 million.<ref>"[https://ir.taskus.com/news-releases/news-release-details/taskus-announces-fiscal-first-quarter-2024-results Task Us Announces Fiscal First Quarter 2024 Results]". 8 May 2024.</ref>

The company employs a total of 47,000 employees in 13 locations;<ref name="Lingle">{{cite web|last=Lingle|first=Brandon|title=Task Us rises amid higher profit in third quarter, despite revenue dip|url=https://www.expressnews.com/business/article/task-us-third-quarter-18475415.php|date=8 November 2023|website=San Antonio Express News}}</ref> the company's principal operations are in the [[Philippines]].<ref name="inc2">{{Cite web |title=How Two High School Friends Turned $25,000 Into an $80 Million Business |author= |work=Inc.com |date= June 2016|access-date=31 August 2021 |url= https://www.inc.com/lindsay-blakely/2016-30-under-30-taskus.html}}</ref><ref name="sec._424B">{{Cite web |title=Task Us prospectus |author= |work=sec.gov |date= |access-date=31 August 2021 |url= https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1829864/000119312521189507/d200167d424b4.htm}}</ref><ref name="bizj_57">{{Cite web |title=Task Us reports more than 57% year-over-year revenue growth - San Antonio Business Journal |author= |work=San Antonio Business Journal |date=12 August 2021 |access-date=31 August 2021 |url= https://www.bizjournals.com/sanantonio/news/2021/08/12/taskus-sees-57-per-yoy-revenue-growth.html}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=Abad|first1=Roderick|title=BPO firm Task Us to invest $25M for PH expansion|url=https://www.abs-cbn.com/business/10/06/14/bpo-firm-taskus-invest-25m-ph-expansion|website=ABS-CBN|date=6 October 2014}}</ref>

Approximately 30% of the company's revenue is from providing [[Criticism of Facebook#Moderators|content moderation for Facebook]], and about 12% is from [[DoorDash]].<ref name="bloo_Blac" /><ref name="bizj_Rese" /><ref name="10q_june2021" /><ref name="nyti_TheS" />

Other customers include [[Coinbase]] (beginning in 2017), [[Netflix]], [[Zoom (software)|Zoom]] (beginning in 2020), [[Whisper]], [[Tinder (app)|Tinder]], [[AutoDesk]], and [[Uber]] (beginning in 2013).<ref name="inc" /><ref name="expr_NewB">{{Cite web |last=Lingle |first=Brandon |date=13 April 2021 |title=New Braunfels' tech firm Task Us files to go public |url=https://www.expressnews.com/business/article/TaskUs-IPO-filing-16097988.php |access-date=31 August 2021 |work=San Antonio Express-News}}</ref>
